A '''life-support module''' was a temporary habitat used by construction workers onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].

==Description==
Each module was clustered together with others to provide larger living spaces for the air-breathing workers.

==History==
The modules served as dwelling places for the workers during the construction phase of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. After the station's completion, the modules were stored inside its immense superstructure to serve as habitats in case of an emergency.
